claim.scope_statement: Every monic P∈Z[X] with only real roots and M(P)>1 satisfies M(P)≥(27/4)^(1/4)>1. For a degree-d monic integer polynomial with real roots and no roots 0,±1, the stronger degree-sensitive bound is M(P)≥(27/4)^(d/8). This does not cover polynomials with nonreal conjugates.
